comment: ANCHOR: JOURNAL_JOURNEY_COMPACT_20261104 — FQ-042: on a phone the journal journey list is a set of dated summaries (symbol · date · account · P/L) with the full row behind a details toggle, so entry/exit/cause no longer repeat before the conflicts and data-gaps sections; nothing is removed and desktop keeps the fully expanded row. Pytest-collectable so the CI shard runner executes it (a .mjs file cannot be collected); apps/command-center-v3/src/lib/journalJourneyCompact.view.test.mjs mirrors it for a node run.
